prompt: The September Declaration has a rough equivalent in the Netherlands that takes place on the same day every year. In what century was the current name of this day (as of August 2024) chosen?
answer: The current name, **Prinsjesdag (“Prince’s Day”)**, was chosen in the **19th century**. It originally referred to the birthday of Stadholder William V on 8 March, but later became associated with the annual State Opening of Parliament in the Netherlands.
